 Olivier-Maxence Prosper contributed five points and two rebounds in 16 minutes as the Memphis Grizzlies secured a 124-121 victory over Cleveland on Wednesday. The 24-year-old forward saw his scoring output decline after delivering consecutive double-digit performances in his previous two appearances.
 Prosper finished the game shooting 2-for-5 from the field, missed both three-point attempts and converted one of two free throws. His contribution came during a stretch of increased playing time, according to reports from CBS Sports and RotoWire published November 19, 2026.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 Before the Cleveland matchup, Prosper had combined for 23 points while shooting 8-for-11 across two consecutive games. His latest performance represented a slowdown following that productive stretch.

 The forward has now played at least 16 minutes in three consecutive appearances. This represents a noticeable increase in involvement compared with his limited opportunities earlier in November, according to CBS Sports and RotoWire.
 Despite the expanded court time, Prosper's playing opportunities remain inconsistent. His modest contributions in areas beyond scoring also continue to limit his fantasy basketball value, particularly in leagues with smaller rosters.
